sourceDescription: Walking in Manila, Philippines. (binaural, please use headset for 3D effect). This binaural audio file is one of the recordings I made in Manila a few days before Christmas 2018, while I was rambling in the shops and in the crowded streets of Divisoria and Baklaran, which are two places where you can find many sellers and vendors who sell everything you’d like to buy... Here, the record starts while im’ walking in a small street, going through some small shops, to arrive finally on a very large avenue where many vehicles are passing by. Then, I will walk there during some minutes. Recorded in
